name: Commerce Monetico
description: Off-site Drupal Commerce payment gateway for Monetico / Cybermut (CM-CIC) — the French banks Crédit Mutuel, CIC, OBC and Monetico. Redirects checkout to the bank's payment kit and processes a server callback whose HMAC-SHA1 seal is recomputed server-side with the merchant security key before the order is placed. Bundles the bank PHP payment kit; depends on Commerce Payment.
project_description:
Commerce Monetico is a module that will provide payment gateway for some french banks on D8, for module Drupal Commerce (2.x):

 
 CIC 
 Crédit Mutuel 
 
 Note: For D7, you can use the module Commerce CM-CIC
